name: Simplify for WooCommerce
author: simplifymystore

sections.description:
Simplify for WooCommerce provides extensive features for removing bloat from Woocommerce and simplifying the WooCommerce admin, making it easier, faster and simpler to run your WooCommerce store.

Major Features

  • Remove unused WooCommerce features
  • Completely hide Shipping features
  • Completely hide Analytics features
  • Completely hide Coupon features
  • Completely hide Stock/Inventory features
  • Completely hide Payments menu
  • Completely hide Reviews menu
  • Remove WooCommerce Product Categories
  • Remove WooCommerce Product Tags
  • Remove WooCommerce Product Brands
  • Remove unused WooCommerce Product types
  • Remove unused WooCommerce Product tabs
  • Remove unused WooCommerce menu items
  • Misc tweaks

Extending Simplify for WooCommerce

PRO Plugin

The PRO Plugin provides extra features and premium support.
sections.installation:
Requirements

  • WooCommerce plugin

Usage

  1. Go to the WooCommerce -> Simplify menu.
  2. Click whichever features you want to disable.
  3. Click Save.
sections.faq:
Is Simplify for WooCommerce free?

Yes, Simplify for WooCommerce core features are free and will always be free.

Does this modify the frontend of my WooCommerce store?

No, this plugin only affects the WooCommerce admin and will only simplify features within the admin.

Will you help me if I am having trouble?

Yes! Please visit our website and create a support ticket.
